user_story:
As a user, I want to test the links on the Links page to ensure they correctly issue API calls and respond with the appropriate status, so that I can verify the functionality of the application.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click on the link with text 'Created', I should not navigate away from the Links page, and the URL should remain as 'https://demoqa.com/links'.
2. When I click on the link with text 'No Content', I should not navigate away from the Links page, and the URL should remain as 'https://demoqa.com/links'.
